build_data_pipeline: build a grain-based data pipeline that tokenizes and batches text from TensorFlow Datasets with Noam packing
create_tokenizer: create a SentencePiece tokenizer from a vocabulary file and validate its special token IDs
run_noam_pack: run Noam packing to concatenate token sequences into fixed-length context-sized chunks
create_batched_tfds: create a batched TensorFlow Datasets DataLoader with configurable preprocessing, shuffling, and worker count
get_input_output: get input, output, and weight arrays from a batch of token IDs for language model training
